ideas.title: Following the Money in Federal Investigations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial dealings of individuals and organizations involved in federal investigations.
questions: What are the financial implications of these investigations?
How do these investigations impact the economy?
ideas.insight: This story would provide a deeper understanding of the financial aspects of these investigations and how they impact the economy.

ideas.title: The Rise of Sex Trafficking in the US
ideas.description: This story would investigate the increasing cases of sex trafficking in the US and the efforts to prevent it.
questions: What are the root causes of sex trafficking?
How can we prevent sex trafficking?
ideas.insight: This story would raise awareness about the issue of sex trafficking and provide insights into the efforts to prevent it.
